editingOrigStartDate.description: The line's dates when Edit Line opened. A start date already in the past is only rejected if the user changed it (a resumed draft can carry one), and a change from these is what triggers the availability warning.

editingIsConsumable.description: Line being edited is a consumable (priced per unit), so its dates do not change the price. Drives a dialog warning only.

editingDateErrors.description: { start, end } error text for the Edit Line date inputs, set by CartSaveQtyChain. Empty object = no errors.

editingNotes.description: Line notes being edited in the Notes dialog. Saved to the cart item as notes, posted as LINE_NOTES (VARCHAR2 2000).

isCustomerRequest.description: True when this cart holds a CUSTOMER (EXTERNAL) request. Derived in InitCartChain from the Request Type picker (request.requestType), falling back to requestOrigin for customer-create-req-page which has no picker. Drives the customer-vs-project header slot and the hiding of the page action buttons while the T&C dialog is open. Replaces the direct `requestOrigin === 'customer'` tests in the markup: since project-create-request became a unified entry point, an EXTERNAL request raised THERE is a customer request even though its origin is 'project'. SubmitRequestChain derives the same answer independently for the T&C gate and the payload.

ppmRateText.description: Shown instead of any price when Fusion PPM prices rentals (global PPM_RATES_ENABLED on); '' otherwise. Set on entry from $application.functions.ppmRateText. Takes precedence over hideRatesForQuote.

hideRatesForQuote.description: True when ENABLE_QUOTES covers this request's origin, so the RATE and SUBTOTAL cells render 'Rate on request' / '—' instead of amounts. The price is settled on the quote (where a manager can still adjust markup and per-line rates), and publishing a figure here would anchor the customer on a number the quote may not honour. Derived in InitCartChain via $application.functions.isQuotingAllowed — the same resolver and rule the catalog card uses, so the two screens never disagree about whether a price is public. Fails CLOSED to false (amounts SHOWN) while settings load.

showHoursColumn.description: True when the HOURS column and the per-line Hours editor should render. Requires BOTH an internal/project request (not EXTERNAL, not the customer flow — those have no hours concept) AND the TIMESHEETS_ENABLED feature flag, which is the app-wide costing-intent switch: with it off the app bills on the complete request period and hours are ignored. Derived in InitCartChain, which is where $application (and therefore the flag) is reachable. Fails CLOSED — false while settings are still loading.

isCreatingContract.description: True while SubmitRequestChain is creating the Fusion sell contract at submit. Drives the full-page loader overlay — that call is the slow, externally-dependent part of submit, and without it the page looks frozen. Set ONLY on the no-quote customer path (customer origin + quoting disabled for CUSTOMER); when quoting is on, the contract is created at quote-accept instead and that page shows its own overlay.

isSubmitting.description: True from the moment SubmitRequestChain begins the actual submit (after T&C gate) until it either errors out or navigates away. Disables the Submit Request button to prevent duplicate submissions.

missingForSubmit.description: Fields a soft reservation still lacks (labels from requestHeaderBody.missingForSubmit), listed in the Complete Request Details popup that SubmitRequestChain opens instead of submitting.
